source: docs/design/phase3-hydrosphere-and-drift.md section 3 and DESIGN.md rule A: an algae vat turns CO2 into O2 one for one (the air loses x kPa of CO2 and gains x kPa of O2; total pressure unchanged; it never takes more CO2 than the air has). Rate 0.10 kPa of CO2 per sol each at full power, draw 2 power units per sol, and 100 biomass units made per kPa converted are all INVENTED game balance (the design's '+20 BU per vat' would need 75 vats for the 1,500 BU target, which the design itself calls too many; biomass here follows the gas moved instead, about 1,500 BU per 15 kPa, balance sheet 3a). 'requires': hydrosphere >= 10 percent (design: vats become placeable at the Hydrosphere line; they need liquid water) and temperature >= 0 C (INVENTED: the culture must not freeze); physical thresholds, never scaled (invariant I-1). Real idea behind it: photobioreactors and the ISS Veggie plant growth hardware (docs/science/machine-references.md); this machine is a game-sized version of a real idea. Unlocked by Phase 3 begins (data/mars/gates/phase_3_begins.json).
